description: This Java class serves as a command handler for submitting loan applications within the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, is annotated as a Service, and processes commands related to creating loan applications.

classes.name: LoanApplicationSubmittalCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class responsible for processing loan application submission commands.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to submit a loan application by delegating to the writePlatformService.
